label: JZ Mock D · Paper 2 · Question 16
knowledgePattern: Prove a minimum number of options by indistinguishable truth patterns
solution:
Fix the actual truth pattern of the five statements. If the student checks all but statement i, the only other pattern that could still agree with everything checked differs from the actual pattern only at i.

For every choice of omitted statement, such an alternative option must be present. The five single-statement changes are all different, so at least five alternatives plus the correct pattern are needed: at least six options.

This is attainable. If the actual true statements are 1 and 2, list the correct option {1,2} and the five alternatives {2}, {1}, {1,2,3}, {1,2,4}, {1,2,5}. Whichever statement is omitted, one alternative remains indistinguishable. The student is not told that exactly two statements are true, so the differing sizes of the alternatives do not rule them out. Answer C.

hints.title: Leave one statement unchecked
hints.body: For a concrete example, suppose statements 1 and 2 are the true ones. Write that correct option. Now leave statement 3 unchecked: what different option agrees on statements 1, 2, 4 and 5?
hints.recap: To make a check necessary, another option must remain possible without it.
hints.pitfall: The student is not told that exactly two statements are true.
hints.pause: Write the extra option needed when statement 3 is not checked.

recall.reminder: To make a check necessary, another option must remain possible without it.

hints.title: Try each possible missing check
hints.body: Repeat this for each other statement that could be left unchecked. Decide whether the same extra option can work for two different missing checks.
hints.recap: To prove a smallest number, show why fewer cannot work and why your list does work.
hints.pitfall: Count the correct option as well as the alternatives.
hints.pause: Make the shortest complete list, then check it against both policies.

recall.reminder: To prove a smallest number, show why fewer cannot work and why your list does work.
